stages.required: Root separately supplies and reads actual capture source/runtime and exact native tool/link/configuration bootstrap bytes before command authority. Receive installed kpsewhich help/version under bounded native capture; accept actual option/format/generator semantics before any lookup.

Run only the separately authorized finite first frontier, keep every native byte/status and default/all result in order, then receive full byte bodies of every returned candidate, including shadows/aliases and configuration chains. No lock is produced.

Read complete article and effective kernel/source context. Derive option processing, selected 10pt size input, all class inputs and optional configuration branches from actual bodies, not a guessed article.cfg. Read all eight packages in manuscript order and their actual option/engine/driver branches, dependent inputs, config checks and begin-document/end-package hooks.

Derive active text/math family, encoding, series, shape, size and substitutions from actual NFSS/kernel/class/package/FD bodies, including maketitle/headings/abstract/theorems/small table/math script sizes/bibliography accents. Derive each metric name using its complete actual FD helper/range/scaling expression; do not reuse the lmodern-only regex or ecrm1095/base-TFM list. Receive TFM and any VF graph before exact selected map lines, encodings and font program bytes. Missing map/metric or unresolved generation stays HOLD; no bitmap/metric/format generator is invoked.

Pin the actual selected pdflatex.fmt binary and distinguish candidate current latex.ltx/pdftexconfig source from proven dump provenance. Establish actual format/kernel semantics used for source reasoning; unresolved mismatch stays HOLD. Receive complete active texmf/config/map/database chain, ordered precedence, used variable expansions, program-specific TeX/Bib search contexts and all relevant filename databases. Do not infer complete closure from the initial 12 variable queries.

Only after separately reviewed native/runtime source, identify exact future pdflatex/BibTeX/query/cmp/env/PDF-tool executable aliases, ELF interpreter and dependency graph; receive loader/locale/device/configuration and renderer/fontconfig/Poppler roles with finite reasoned named memberships. Any ldd script/interpreter/RTLDLIST or runtime probe first requires fresh source/runtime authority. No old840 set or six old membership roots is silently copied.

Only after every named graph edge closes and current full source/tool/runtime/config pins close before/after, root may separately construct and receive a fresh bounded P212 lock. Requery and bind effective search settings/relative roots under the exact later cold build cwd; first-query cwd state is not transferable absence evidence. Then receive actual small builder diff and separate build authority.

stop_conditions: An installed option/generator contract is unsupported or unclear
A required direct seed or required active source edge has no actual resolution/body
A query result cannot be unambiguously paired with its one requested name/program
A dynamic TeX/NFSS/configuration branch is not manually justified by whole source bodies
A candidate current kernel source is assumed to equal the compiled-format kernel without evidence
Any new graph/name/tool/membership exceeds the last separately received finite frontier
Any source/alias/config/runtime entry changes or native output is unsettled
Any attempt tries to infer an input from a failed build or repairs/retries/installs/generates resources
excluded_automatic_selectors: PDF/FLS/font list from a failed or unbound build
best-effort parser treating unrecognized macros as absent edges
